channel.title: Pier & Point · Helen Diller Family Cancer Research Building
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Helen Diller Family Cancer Research Building (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Helen Diller Family Cancer Research Building: The size 161,757 sq ft plus 20,000 sq ft of vivarium space was not in any readable source; SFGate (May 2009) says nearly 164,000 sq ft and the architect's page gives a conflicting 174,020 with a mislabelled unit, so the record now says about 164,000 and notes the conflict. SFGate says Helen Diller and her husband contributed $35 million but does not call it the largest individual gift, so that phrase was removed from the cost entry and the related timeline entry. The 2006 groundbreaking is now dated by year only (the source gives no month), and the June 2009 opening also cites SFGate. The aerial photo's caption no longer says 'from a departing flight'.
item.description: The size 161,757 sq ft plus 20,000 sq ft of vivarium space was not in any readable source; SFGate (May 2009) says nearly 164,000 sq ft and the architect's page gives a conflicting 174,020 with a mislabelled unit, so the record now says about 164,000 and notes the conflict. SFGate says Helen Diller and her husband contributed $35 million but does not call it the largest individual gift, so that phrase was removed from the cost entry and the related timeline entry. The 2006 groundbreaking is now dated by year only (the source gives no month), and the June 2009 opening also cites SFGate. The aerial photo's caption no longer says 'from a departing flight'. Source: SFGate, 2009-05-31 (https://www.sfgate.com/health/article/135-million-UCSF-cancer-research-site-to-open-3229463.php); Rafael Vinoly Architects, Helen Diller Family Cancer Research Building (https://www.rvapc.com/works/university-of-california-san-francisco-helen-diller-family-cancer-research-building/); A History of UCSF, 1990-2009 (https://history.library.ucsf.edu/1990.html).
